brief:
Israel's tightened blockade on Gaza has caused prices to spike dramatically across the territory, according to Al Jazeera English. The restrictions have severely disrupted supply chains and forced residents to seek alternative means of obtaining basic necessities and fuel for energy production.

Lighters and fans have emerged as critical items in Gaza's economy as Palestinians adapt to acute shortages of conventional energy sources. With fuel supplies restricted and electricity generation limited, residents have increasingly relied on these improvised tools to meet heating and cooling needs. The blockade has fundamentally altered consumption patterns, pushing typically inexpensive goods into scarce, high-demand categories that command inflated prices in local markets.
dek: As Israel tightens its blockade on Gaza, both lighters and fans have become the backbone of energy in the strip.
title: Israel's tightened Gaza blockade drives prices skyward
